rationale: The agency's call with the contractor confirms the work is complete, including a lock change (013); the call summary names other properties, which is noise, and the agency's own hold records 'Maya done repair - he will drop new key off and send invoice' (016). With the lock changed, the office needs the new key before the job can close, so a dated follow-up for the key is right; chasing the contractor for the key and invoice is acceptable. The contractor's later email only restates the appointment (018); the key was brought in and copied (020) and the job closed after that (023). Closing before the key arrives leaves the office without a key to a changed lock; booking again duplicates finished work; no invoice amount exists to approve; nothing makes the tenant liable.
